Thanks, Ava — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying items before we issue the PO:

1) Confirm the exact legal name to appear on the PO (you listed Redwood Inference, Inc. — correct?)
2) Please confirm the tax ID as you provided (EIN). We will need a matching W-9.
3) For the DPA: we prefer to send our version first; will you review/redline and return or should we sign your DocuSign copy?
4) Subprocessor CSV: can you confirm the last updated date on that list? We need it to be within the last 30 days.

If we get confirmations by EOD today we will start routing the PO. Also — for U.S. payments we route via our AP system (we need ACH or wire details later in the invoice). Let me know if you want us to create the PO to your invoice email or route through a procurement portal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Linda
